title: A full likelihood fit of the single LZ event in (m_chi, delta, sigma): where does inelastic dark matter actually prefer to sit?
question: Using an extended likelihood in observed recoil energy (WimPyDD O1 spectra, efficiency roll-off, 11 keV resolution, high-energy NR-band background b_H and P016's low-energy bins), where in (m_chi, delta, sigma_n) does the inelastic O1 (isoscalar/isovector) likelihood peak, what are the 68/90% regions, does the maximum lie beyond LZ's 350 keV grid edge, and how does the profile Z(delta) compare with Table S7?
headline_result: The isoscalar O1 likelihood maximum lies beyond LZ's grid at delta = 380 keV for 1000 GeV (Z = 3.59 sigma; 2-dof 68% region 360-385 keV, 90% 330-390 keV), 400 keV at 4000 GeV and the kinematic ceiling 340 keV at 400 GeV, with (c1s mv2)^2 = 2.19 (sigma_n = 6.5e-38 cm^2) and a likelihood ratio 4.7 over delta = 350 keV; Z rises because 248 keV moves from the 99.2th observed percentile to the median and collapses within 15 keV of the ceiling because the recoil window slides above the event, not because the rate vanishes; a pure Higgsino sits inside the 68% band at delta = 365-370 keV
key_numbers: Z(1000 GeV O1s) = 2.67/3.12/3.42/3.59/3.47/3.16/0 at delta = 300/350/370/380/385/390/395 keV; Table S7 rms 0.40 sigma, mean -0.09 (O1s low 0.2-0.9, O1v high 0.2-0.6); kappa_hat = 7.4e-5 (300), 3.9e-3 (350), 2.19 (380; 68% 0.66-5.2, 90% 0.23-8.0); sigma_n(380) = 6.5e-38 cm^2 (2.0e-38-1.5e-37); mu_hat = 1.0 event; dq0 peak-300 = 5.7, peak-350 = 3.1; 2-dof 68% delta 360-385 keV kappa 0.013-35, 90% 330-390 keV; peaks 340/380/400 keV for 400/1000/4000 GeV; O1v flat 3.55-3.68; variants shift peak <= 5 keV (Sun frame 370, E_obs 262 -> 385); Fig.6 upper edges x1.02-1.06 (250-300 keV), x0.63 at 350 (Sun frame x1.08); Higgsino kappa 0.0777 in 68% band at 365-370 keV, fixed-coupling best 370 (360-380), delta(N=1) 365.5; exact single-event Z 3.36-3.57 (335-390 keV); global 2.8-3.0 sigma with N_eff 9-15; E* = delta mu/m_N = 261/354/420 keV at the ceiling
model_or_mechanism: extended likelihood in observed recoil energy: WimPyDD shell-model O1 (isoscalar, isovector, P007 Higgsino couplings) inelastic spectra via per-stream kernels on explicit v_min grid, annual/June/Sun-frame Baxter halos, efficiency 0.96 with erf edges (5.4/269.9 keV), sqrt(E) Gaussian resolution, P016 Fig. 5 sigma-bins with profiled ER scale, 125-200 keV empty bin, flat b_H in 200-270 keV; coupling profiled per (m, delta); asymptotic q0 plus toy-free exact single-event p; 2-dof (delta, kappa) surface
confidence: medium: reproduces Table S7 to 0.4 sigma and Fig. 6 edges to 6%, but 1D observed-energy proxy for LZ's 2D PDFs, b_H anchored on P016, asymptotic Z in the one-event regime
builds_on: LZ arXiv:2609.02823 (Table S7, Fig. 6, LEE supplement, O1-as-sigma); refines P002, P007; uses P003, P008, P009, P016
